messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT — anomalous output rate and increased hallucination score for tenant `atlashealth` on /models/atlas/v1/generate · detected by output-quality-monitor · link: https://observability.redwood.internal/alerts/ATLAS-3075554321 :rotating_light:
Mike (oncall): ack. paging eng-runtime + eng-ml. starting triage. any immediate mitigation options? :raised_hand:
Ben (eng-runtime): looking. initial telemetry shows long tail in token-latency + some 502s when sequence length > 2k. dedicated pool for atlashealth is healthy but current routing still to mixed capacity. can route to their reserved pool and apply per-tenant request-rate cap.
Siva (eng-ml): from content side we're seeing a regression with the new LLM blend variant (v2-blend) that drifts on safety checks. safe-ish fallback exists: `atlas-safe-v2-qs` (quantized safety-tuned variant). recommend isolating tenant -> safe variant, and enable request-level scrubbing for a short window.
Tony (eng-infra): I can flip tenant routing quickly. two steps: 1) set tenant override to safe variant 2) apply soft throttling to large batch requests.
Carla (qa): can we canary 5% before global? low-risk path preferred.
Alice (customer-success): FYI I already pinged AtlasHealth SRE (cc @atlas-sre on their side) and they reported customer-facing sessions saw odd responses starting ~15:05 UTC. they're asking for immediate mitigation.
Mike (oncall): due to customer visible impact, authorize full switch now. Ben/Siva/Tony please proceed, and post the exact commands you run here.
Ben (eng-runtime): running tenant routing change now. command:
```bash
# set tenant override to safe variant
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/atlashealth/override \
  -d '{"target_model":"atlas-safe-v2-qs","mode":"force","reason":"active hallucination regression"}'
```
Ben (eng-runtime): response: 200 OK, override_id=ovr-98a3f. routing table updated.
Dave (oncall-2): I triggered the request-scrubber and set batch_size_max=16 for atlashealth:
```json
{"tenant":"atlashealth","batch_size_max":16,"scrub_level":"high"}
```
Siva (eng-ml): enabling model-level suppression for high-risk tokens and safety filter override rules now. small config diff applied. logs showing initial safety-pass rate jump from 77% -> 96%.
Carla (qa): observing traffic spike as we reroute — initial sample (5s): 0/120 responses flagged. looks good so far.
Alice (customer-success): AtlasHealth SRE confirmed they see reduced bad responses. they've asked for ETA to return to original variant once root cause fixed.
Jen (acct-exec): drafting customer note. suggested short message: "We've routed your traffic to a safety-verified variant and applied temporary protections. We're investigating and will update within 2 hours." want to send now?
Mike (oncall): send now. please copy postmortem link when ready.
Ben (eng-runtime): created incident ticket: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INC-4132 — assigned to Siva/Ben.
Siva (eng-ml): owning postmortem; will run evals on v2-blend and roll forward or rollback depending on fix. ETA for initial root-cause hypothesis: 4h.
Tony (eng-infra): leaving the tenant override in force and setting TTL 6h. command:
```bash
# TTL on override
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/overrides/ovr-98a3f \
  -d '{"ttl_seconds":21600}'
```
Dave (oncall-2): posting short ops playbook here for handoff and rollback steps:
- rollback override: `DELETE /api/v1/overrides/ovr-98a3f`
- emergency pin back: `POST /tenants/atlashealth/override { target_model: atlas-v1-stable }`
- if consumer API latency > 500ms, shift to warm standby in us-west-2
Carla (qa): quick note — keep an eye on embeddings endpoint too, saw a small uptick in similarity drift for the tenant. Siva please include embeddings checks in the postmortem.
Alice (customer-success): AtlasHealth asked for a short status update to their engineering lead. here's the message I'll send (ready to send):
"We have temporarily routed your requests to a safety-tuned model variant and applied request-level protections. We will keep this configuration for up to 6 hours while we investigate. No action needed from your side; we'll follow up with a security/quality report and remediation plan."
Jen (acct-exec): sent at 15:35 UTC. cc'ed legal & security per contract.
Mike (oncall): monitoring dashboard looks stable — error-rate down to baseline. leaving page open; handoff to Ben for daytime ops. Ben take it.
Ben (eng-runtime): taking lead. will coordinate with Siva for remediation windows and QA for staged reintroduction.
Siva (eng-ml): next steps: run differential evals across prompt-sets, produce patch for v2-blend model weights or revert to last known-good. will update in INC-4132.
Tony (eng-infra): leaving override with TTL, will remove TTL if change is long-lived.
Dave (oncall-2): creating brief runbook note in `/confluence/incidents/atlashealth-3075554321` and attaching logs.
Mike (oncall): thanks team. reminder: postmortem required within 48h, Siva owner. I'll close P1 when rollback plan or final fix is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
